notes.subject: עניתי
notes.rationale: Lemma ענה can mean 'answer' or 'be afflicted'; most versions take 'I was greatly afflicted', but 'I answered greatly' is possible.

notes.subject: duŋɔra
notes.rationale: Hebrew עניתי 'I was afflicted' rendered with 'duŋɔ' (be ill/oppressed), the nearest Bamanankan picture of affliction.

notes.subject: sabu
notes.rationale: כי read as causal 'because'; JPS reads it as concessive 'even when I spoke'.

translation: Ne sinna, sabu ne bɛ kuma: anwu ne, ne tun duŋɔra kosɛbɛ.
